title: Binance Introduces Maximum Negative Balance to Portfolio Margin Program
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Starting from  2025-01-22 00:00 (UTC) , there will be a  Maximum Negative Balance  applied to the  Portfolio Margin Program . The  Auto-Exchange  process will be triggered to repay any negative balance when the negative balance of any margin asset exceeds the corresponding  Maximum Negative Balance . How Does It Work: The system will calculate the negative balance of each asset every 10 minutes. Once the negative balance of any asset exceeds the Maximum Negative Balance, the Auto-Exchange process will be triggered. The system will first  cancel any open orders with margin locked  corresponding to the negative balance asset and repay the negative balance such that it falls below 80% of the asset’s Maximum Negative Balance. Please note that  the open order will only be canceled if the locked asset is a negative balance asset. If the negative balance of the asset  fails to fall below 80%  of the asset’s Maximum Negative Balance after the repayment, the system will exchange other assets for repayment. The assets selected for exchange will be chosen at random.. This will continue until the negative balance of the asset falls below 80% of the asset’s Maximum Negative Balance. Where to Query Record: From the Binance Web and App, please click “Portfolio Margin Orders” - “Others” for the Auto-Exchange record (Please note it will only be available for query until further notification   on App).  From API, please query the auto-exchange record via GET /papi/v1/portfolio/negative-balance-exchange-record Note: For more information about Maximum Negative Balance, please refer to this FAQ “ Wallet Transfers, Auto Fund Functions, and Negative Balances in Binance Portfolio Margin ”. Please note that the Maximum Negative Balance of each asset will only be available on  this page  when the product goes live on  2025-01-22 00:00 (UTC) . Users will be notified via email, in-app and App push notifications when the Auto-Exchange is triggered.  The user’s account will be marked as Reduce-Only during the Auto-Exchange process. The Maximum Negative Balance only applies to the  Portfolio Margin Program , not the  Portfolio Margin Pro Program . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Guides & Related Materials: Introduction to Binance Portfolio Margin Mode Wallet Transfers, Auto Fund Functions, and Negative Balances in Binance Portfolio Margin Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-14 Note: This announcement was updated on 2025-11-24 to clarify that the exchange on assets selection is random.
